# paper-pptx API reference

The complete public API of `pptx` 0.2.0, generated from docstrings. The distribution is `paper-pptx`, a fork of python-pptx; the import name is `pptx`. Both what the fork adds and the API it inherits from python-pptx are documented here.

This index names every symbol documented here. Open the one page you need rather than reading them all.

## `pptx.compose`

Cross-presentation slide import and deck merge (paper-pptx addition).

Full contract: [compose.md](compose.md)

- `ImportReport` — What one import did. Deterministic; `.to_dict()` is goldenable.
- `PackageTransaction` — Restore a package's original live graph if the guarded operation raises.
- `SCHEMA_NAME = 'paper-import-report'`
- `SCHEMA_VERSION = 3`
- `append_deck(dest_prs, source_prs, *, mode, notes=True) -> 'Tuple[ImportReport, ...]'` — Import every `source_prs` slide, in order, at the end of `dest_prs`.
- `import_slide(dest_prs, source_prs, slide, *, mode, position=None, notes=True, section=None, section_id=None, target_layout=None, placeholder_map='auto') -> ImportReport` — Import one slide from `source_prs` into `dest_prs`; return the `ImportReport`.

## `pptx.diff`

Deck diff - the verification mirror (paper-pptx addition).

Full contract: [diff.md](diff.md)

- `BulletShift` — One paragraph whose resolved bullet changed between the two decks.
- `DeckDiff` — The whole comparison. `.to_dict()` is deterministic and goldenable.
- `EffectiveShift` — One uniquely matched run in a unique unchanged paragraph whose resolved font changed.
- `MovedSlide` — A slide that kept its identity and changed position.
- `SCHEMA_NAME = 'paper-deck-diff'`
- `SCHEMA_VERSION = 5`
- `ShapeRef` — Identifies a slide-scoped shape by stable id and display name.
- `SlideChange` — Within-slide deltas for one id-matched slide pair. Empty facets are omitted
- `SlideRef` — Identifies a slide by id, position, and title.
- `diff_decks(path_a, path_b, *, detail='structure') -> DeckDiff` — Compare two decks; return the typed `DeckDiff`.

## `pptx.errors`

Typed safe-refusal exceptions for paper-pptx APIs.

Full contract: [errors.md](errors.md)

- `AmbiguousTargetError` — The addressing given matches more than one target; refusing to pick one.
- `BoundaryViolationError` — An operation ran outside the scope where it is safe.
- `PackageLimitError` — The package archive has no single unambiguous reading, or is unsafe to expand.
- `PaperRefusal` — Base class for all safe refusals raised by paper-pptx APIs.
- `RelationshipPolicyError` — The relationship graph cannot be carried across as asked.
- `StaleAnchorError` — The block at an anchor's position no longer matches the anchor's content hash.
- `TargetNotFoundError` — The target could not be resolved in this document.
- `UnsupportedStructureError` — This API cannot operate safely on the document as it stands.
- `materialize_slides(prs, operation)` — Return `list(prs.slides)`, refusing typed when the relationship graph is broken.

## `pptx.inspect`

Effective-style inspection: resolved font values with provenance (paper-pptx).

Full contract: [inspect.md](inspect.md)

- `BULLET_FOLLOWS_TEXT = 'follow text'`
- `BlockAnchor` — A structural current anchor or conservative three-field legacy anchor.
- `DECK_MANIFEST_SCHEMA = 'paper-deck-manifest'`
- `DECK_MANIFEST_VERSION = 1`
- `DeckManifest` — Structural survey of a whole deck. `.to_dict()` is deterministic (golden-tested).
- `EffectiveBullet` — The bullet that actually renders on one paragraph, with its provenance chain.
- `EffectiveFont` — Effective size, name, color, and emphasis of one run.
- `EffectiveParagraphFormat` — Effective alignment, line spacing, and bullet of one paragraph (paper-pptx addition).
- `EffectiveShapeFormat` — Effective solid fill and line color of one shape (paper-pptx addition).
- `EffectiveValue` — A resolved (or honestly-unresolved) effective value with its provenance chain.
- `InspectedRun` — One run of text paired with the font that renders it.
- `ProvenanceStep` — One consulted level of an inheritance walk.
- `SCHEMA_NAME = 'paper-text-inspection'`
- `SCHEMA_VERSION = 3`
- `ShapeManifest` — Structural facts of one shape (paper-pptx addition). Group children nest.
- `SlideManifest` — Structural facts of one slide.
- `TextBlock` — One paragraph of one text body, with anchor and per-run effective fonts.
- `TextInspection` — Inspection payload for one slide. `.to_dict()` is deterministic (golden-tested).
- `content_hash(text) -> str` — First 8 hex chars of SHA-256 over the NFC-normalized text (the pinned anchor hash).
- `effective_font(run) -> EffectiveFont` — Return the `EffectiveFont` for `run`, a `_Run` on a slide shape.
- `effective_paragraph_format(paragraph) -> EffectiveParagraphFormat` — Return effective alignment, line spacing, and bullet for `paragraph`, with provenance.
- `effective_shape_format(shape) -> EffectiveShapeFormat` — Return the effective solid fill and line color of `shape`, with provenance.
- `inspect_deck(prs) -> DeckManifest` — Return a structural `DeckManifest` of `prs` (paper-pptx addition).
- `inspect_text(slide) -> TextInspection` — Return a `TextInspection` of every text block on `slide`, visibility-complete.
- `iter_text_bodies(spTree)` — Yield `(kind, owner_elm, txBody, group_path, cell_coordinates)` in document order.

## `pptx.oxml.xmlchemy`

Base and meta classes enabling declarative definition of custom element classes.

Full contract: [oxml.xmlchemy.md](oxml.xmlchemy.md)

- `AttributeType` — Interface for an object that can act as an attribute type.
- `BaseAttribute` — Base class for OptionalAttribute and RequiredAttribute, providing common methods.
- `BaseOxmlElement` — Effective base class for all custom element classes.
- `Choice` — Defines a child element belonging to a group, only one of which may appear as a child.
- `MetaOxmlElement` — Metaclass for BaseOxmlElement.
- `OneAndOnlyOne` — Defines a required child element for MetaOxmlElement.
- `OneOrMore` — Defines a repeating child element for MetaOxmlElement that must appear at least once.
- `OptionalAttribute` — Defines an optional attribute on a custom element class.
- `OxmlElement(nsptag_str, nsmap=None) -> BaseOxmlElement` — Return a "loose" lxml element having the tag specified by `nsptag_str`.
- `RequiredAttribute` — Defines a required attribute on a custom element class.
- `XmlString` — Provides string comparison override suitable for serialized XML; useful for tests.
- `ZeroOrMore` — Defines an optional repeating child element for MetaOxmlElement.
- `ZeroOrOne` — Defines an optional child element for MetaOxmlElement.
- `ZeroOrOneChoice` — An `EG_*` element group where at most one of its members may appear as a child.
- `serialize_for_reading(element)` — Serialize *element* to human-readable XML suitable for tests. No XML

## `pptx.table`

Table-related objects such as Table and Cell.

Full contract: [table.md](table.md)

- `Table` — A DrawingML table object.

## `pptx.text.bullet`

BulletFormat proxy, providing bullet and numbering control for a paragraph (paper-pptx).

Full contract: [text.bullet.md](text.bullet.md)

- `BulletFormat` — Bullet and numbering state of a single paragraph.
- `DEFAULT_BULLET_HANGING_INDENT = Emu(171450)`
- `DEFAULT_BULLET_LEFT_MARGIN = Emu(342900)`

## `pptx.text.fonts`

Objects related to system font file lookup.

Full contract: [text.fonts.md](text.fonts.md)

- `FontFiles` — A class-based singleton serving as a lazy cache for system font details.

## `pptx.text.layout`

Objects related to layout of rendered text, such as TextFitter.

Full contract: [text.layout.md](text.layout.md)

- `TextFitter` — Value object that knows how to fit text into given rectangular extents.

## `pptx.text.text`

Text-related objects such as TextFrame and Paragraph.

Full contract: [text.text.md](text.text.md)

- `Font` — Character properties object, providing font size, font name, bold, italic, etc.
- `TextFrame` — The part of a shape that contains its text.

## `pptx.types`

Abstract types used by `python-pptx`.

Full contract: [types.md](types.md)

- `ProvidesExtents` — An object that has width and height.
- `ProvidesPart` — An object that provides access to its XmlPart.

## `pptx.util`

Utility functions and classes.

Full contract: [util.md](util.md)

- `Centipoints` — Convenience constructor for length in hundredths of a point.
- `Cm` — Convenience constructor for length in centimeters.
- `Emu` — Convenience constructor for length in english metric units.
- `Inches` — Convenience constructor for length in inches.
- `Length` — Base class for length classes Inches, Emu, Cm, Mm, and Pt.
- `Mm` — Convenience constructor for length in millimeters.
- `Pt` — Convenience value class for specifying a length in points.
- `lazyproperty` — Decorator like @property, but evaluated only on first access.
